name: champion-memory-v1
hypothesis: An explicit compact current-run record of incident history, unresolved commitments, review weakness and realised investment benefits improves continuity and avoids forgetting compared with the unchanged parent; one pilot checks feasibility only.
change: Keep every parent priority unchanged; append one short memory section and require its facts in the existing action note. No new strategy rules, numerical thresholds, event mappings or runtime changes.
predicted_behaviour: Action notes carry compact current-run facts, distinguish incident history from current warnings, preserve open commitments and verified payoffs; log recovery occurs only when context is missing. Existing safety and weak-review plans remain active.
refutation: Feasibility fails if the agent omits or fabricates memory, loses incident history after a calmer warning, or stops before an explicit ending for a memory-related reason. One episode cannot establish a score or survival advantage.
notes: User confirmed GPT-6 Luna + Ale champion on 27 October 2026. Exactly one isolated native-model pilot authorised; no central registration, no shared race restart. Parent frozen from cloud26e976f; separate from the unplayed Haiku4+4 study.
idea_origin: Matteo requests one exploratory game with memory on the current champion
